supersedes_finding.finding: Execution result is rebound to policy changed during execution
supersedes_finding.resolution: Original binding persisted in run payload; record compares expected binding and writes that same frozen computed value; policy scope deep snapshot; cache-hit binding checked.

independent_cases.drift: Conflict; zero evidence; durable original result
independent_cases.restoration: original v1 policy recovers without subprocess

independent_cases.observed: Written evidence remains original v1 scope+policy; current v2 lookup misses
Snapshot keeps v1 policy and original nested scope together

inspection.running_race: Conflict leaves durable result and no new-policy evidence
inspection.writeback_race: Mutation before binding rejects; mutation after comparison preserves original binding and cannot relabel evidence
inspection.replay: Fresh policy/context must match original durable request; restored v1 replay uses persisted binding and no respawn
inspection.cache_hit: Mismatch against initial reservation rejects and holds; matching historical cached result remains fact requiring fresh release validation
inspection.compatibility: expected_binding defaults None; existing callers retain behavior. cwd defaults None; all native and process helper tests pass.

method_learning.application: Review exact corrected source bytes and actual outcomes; previous rejected receipt remains historical.
method_learning.feedback: Post-comparison races require verifying evidence identity, not merely requiring every policy update to abort.

limits: Windows local actual subprocess verification; parent owns Linux evidence.
No source changes, commits, pushes, models, deployments or business acceptance.
Trusted host and storage prerequisite; same-key completed/cached responses remain historical facts.
cleanup: All independent TemporaryDirectory fixtures cleaned; suites own and clean fixtures; private review receipt retained.
